/regions/[back_hill]/description: A gentle hill right behind the village. Wood and iron ore lying all over—it's a rookie's playground!
/regions/[back_hill]/monsters/[boar]/des: Gets mad, charges at anything! Watch your backside.
/regions/[back_hill]/monsters/[boar]/pee: Wrestling a boar! Watch your backside!
/regions/[back_hill]/monsters/[bees]/des: Perfectly nice—if you leave the hive alone. Mostly.
/regions/[back_hill]/monsters/[bees]/pee: Bees on our tail! Don't poke the hive!
/regions/[back_hill]/monsters/[squirrel]: Throws acorns. Hurts more than you'd think.
A big squirrel's throwing acorns! Ow!
All-out acorn war with a squirrel!
/regions/[old_mine]/description: A mine abandoned long ago. Dark and damp, but word is there's still loads of coal and silver down there!
/regions/[old_mine]/monsters/[bats]/desc: Pros at tangling your hair. Wear a hat!
/regions/[old_mine]/monsters/[bats]/peek: Bat brawl! Hang on to your hat!
Bat stuck in my hair! Getting it out!
/regions/[old_mine]/monsters/[mine_slime: Slippery, sticky, gross. Your boots will weep.
Slip-'n'-slide showdown with a mine slime!
Stepped in slime! My poor boots~
/regions/[old_mine]/monsters/[golem_kid]: Tiny, but a rock's still a rock. Dodge when it rolls!
Small but rock-hard! Fighting a baby golem!
/regions/[goblin_forest]/description: Deep woods where goblins have set up camp. Leather and shiny manastones galore—and traps galore, too!
/regions/[goblin_forest]/monsters/[gobli: Tails you quietly, then bangs a drum for backup.
Goblin scout! Nab it before it drums!
A goblin's tailing us! Turning to fight!
/regions/[goblin_forest]/monsters/[toads: One whiff of spores and the world goes wobbly.
/regions/[goblin_forest]/monsters/[giant: Sticky webs. And a pro at swinging off to safety.
Giant spider fight! Ew, sticky webs!
Spider's escaping up its thread! After it!
/regions/[volcano]/description: A sweltering cave of bubbling lava. Mithril and firestone await—but your boot soles might melt!
/regions/[volcano]/monsters/[lava_slime]: Looks squishy. Touch it? Ow, hot! Gloves required.
Lava slime fight! Ow ow, hot!
Gloves on, scraping off a lava slime!
/regions/[volcano]/monsters/[fire_lizard: Its tail's on fire. Sometimes it scares itself.
Fire lizard fight! Mind that tail!
The lizard just spooked itself with its own tail!
/regions/[volcano]/monsters/[ash_imp]/de: A little pest that flings ash and runs off cackling.
/regions/[dragon_nest]/description: An old dragon naps in this mountaintop nest. The trick? Sneak off with the scales it sheds! Don't jump at the snoring.
/regions/[dragon_nest]/monsters/[wyvern_: Cheeps for its mom. Pecks like a grown-up, though.
Cheep cheep! Squaring off with a wyvern chick!
/regions/[dragon_nest]/monsters/[drake_g: A dutiful nest guard. Not supposed to doze off. Keeps dozing off.
We woke the snoozing drake guard! Fight!
Toe to toe with a drake guard!
/regions/[dragon_nest]/monsters/[sleepy_: Do NOT wake it! It breathes fire in its sleep sometimes.
Shh… tiptoeing past the dragon… yikes, sleep-fire!
The old dragon's rolling over! Careful, careful!
/regions/[frost_canyon]/description: Crunch, crunch with every step! Frost crystals sparkle in every icy crack. Slip, and you'll slide for ages.
/regions/[frost_canyon]/monsters/[frost_: Every flap freezes its snot. Its secret weapon? Sneezing.
/regions/[frost_canyon]/monsters/[snow_y: Snowball champion. Getting hit is less 'ouch,' more 'brrr.'
Snowball fight with a little yeti! Brr!
/regions/[frost_canyon]/monsters/[ice_go: Slow and solid. A bit melty on sunny days.
A slooow-motion duel with an ice golem!
Tough golem! Hit the melty spot!
/regions/[sky_ruins]/description: Ancient ruins bobbing above the clouds. Windy up here—hold on to your hat! Rumor says a Sky Core's hidden inside.
/regions/[sky_ruins]/monsters/[ruin_wisp: Acts like it's showing you the way, then gets you lost. Little rascal.
The wisp's leading us the wrong way! After it!
Playing tag with a cheeky wisp!
/regions/[sky_ruins]/monsters/[stone_gua: Guarding the same spot for a thousand years. Its legs went numb ages ago.
Stone guardian fight! Its legs are numb—it's slow!
/regions/[sky_ruins]/monsters/[sky_drake: Zips through the clouds! Can't resist anything shiny.
Sky drake dive! It's after the shiny stuff!
Dogfight with a drake above the clouds!
